title: Mesomerie: begrifflichen Merksatz abrufen
description: Die lernende Person kann die unveränderte Atomverknüpfung und unterschiedliche Elektronenverteilung mesomerer Grenzstrukturen als delokalisiertes Modell mithilfe der zugehörigen Lernkarten sicher abrufen.
descriptionEn: The learner can reliably recall the unchanged atomic connectivity and different electron distributions of resonance structures as a delocalised model using the associated flashcards.

memorySupportSelection.role: Recall of previously taught compact content only. No ordinary competency, source duty, acquisition performance, or Human evidence is certified.
memorySupportSelection.selectionSemantics: Unchanged getSrsFilterTags returns the existing goal: tags because no GK/LK or new selector tag is added. The unchanged card filter uses their OR intersection; actual ordered cards are checked, not inferred from selectedCardIds.
